user.title: Choose a TV
user.description: Pick the TV's media player from the integration that already runs it (LG webOS, Roku, Android TV, Samsung, SmartThings, Sony and others).

input_lock.name: Input lock
input_lock.description: Keep the TV on the input you allow.

data.enforce_on_power_on: Enforce when the TV turns on

data_description.allowed_sources: Usually just one, e.g. the Apple TV's HDMI input. Anything else gets switched away from.
data_description.target_source: Leave empty to use the first allowed input.
data_description.enforce_on_power_on: Also switch to the input when the TV powers on without reporting one.
data_description.max_attempts: Pauses the lock if the TV keeps refusing, so it isn't spammed.

screen_time.name: Screen time
screen_time.description: Daily limit and times the TV must stay off.

data_description.daily_budget: 0 means no daily limit. When it runs out, the TV is turned off and kept off until tomorrow.
data_description.warn_minutes: Fires a tv_mgmt_warning event you can use for a notification or announcement.
data_description.quiet_windows: Times the TV stays off, comma separated, e.g. 20:30-07:00 Bedtime, 08:00-15:00 School
data_description.adult_mode_duration: How long the adult mode switch lifts all rules before turning itself off.

sync.name: Apple TV Mgmt
sync.description: Link this TV to an Apple TV Mgmt profile.

data_description.mode_sync_entity: Changing the mode in either integration changes the other. At startup, Apple TV Mgmt's mode wins. Leave empty to keep them separate.

error.no_sources: Pick at least one allowed input.
error.target_not_allowed: The input to force back to must be one of the allowed inputs.
error.target_required: Pick the HDMI input to force back to.
error.bad_quiet_windows: Quiet windows must look like 20:30-07:00 Bedtime, separated by commas.

abort.already_configured: This TV already has a profile.

grant_extension.name: Grant extra time
grant_extension.description: Add (or take away) minutes from today's screen time. Unblocks within seconds if the limit was reached.

profile_id.name: Profile
profile_id.description: The TV Mgmt profile (one per TV).

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Minutes to add. Negative to take time away.

force_block.name: Block now
force_block.description: Turn the TV off and keep it off until unblocked or the day ends.

profile_id.name: Profile
profile_id.description: The TV Mgmt profile (one per TV).

unblock.name: Unblock
unblock.description: Lift a block started with Block now. Time limits and quiet windows still apply.
